episodes.title: The Trans Death Cult the Media Won’t Cover | Andy Ngo on the Zizians
episodes.description:
Journalist Andy Ngo joins me to talk about his new book on the Zizians. They are a cult of trans-identifying rationalists linked to killings across several US states, including the 2025 shooting of a Border Patrol agent in Vermont. The mainstream media has barely touched the story.

Andy spent a year and a half investigating the group. He traveled to California, tracked down their hideouts, and interviewed people who knew them. We cover how Ziz built a following out of the Bay Area’s rationalist and effective altruism scene, the strange beliefs about AI and the brain that drove the group, and how members have allegedly exploited fears of being called “transphobic” to stall court cases for years. We also discuss the wider network of activists and legal groups that has supported them.

None of the members have been convicted yet. Several are in custody in at least three states, facing state and federal charges.

https://www.hachettebookgroup.com/titles/andy-ngo/the-zizians/9780316599030/

episodes.title: Ben Appel: I Escaped a Religious Cult — Then Found a Woke Cult at Columbia
episodes.description:
Ben Appel grew up in a religious cult where punishment for sin was an ever-present threat,  endured homophobic bullying public school in the 1990s, got sober after years of addiction — and then walked into Columbia University in 2017, where he was assigned a new label: cis white gay. His memoir, Cis White Gay, traces the line from fundamentalist shame to Ivy League dogma, and argues the two aren't as different as they look.

In this conversation, Ben and Jenny talk about spiritual abuse and its parallels to sexual abuse, the OCD/scrupulosity Ben developed as a child and which resurfaced at Columbia, why victimhood became social currency on campus, Foucault and the anti-capitalist roots of queer theory, how woke encourages people to fail, and what it cost him in friendships to say what he actually thought.
